parsed.seniority_signal: At least three years taking models from data collection through training to something that ran in production or on real hardware, and stayed working.
parsed.notes:
“Things that would stand out” is treated as an optional qualifications heading.
Alternative group 1 also includes the unmapped generative modelling option; generative modelling is not equated with LLMs because it includes non-language models.
Large-scale data tooling is not equated with data pipelines or a particular tool; none is named.
Data collection is treated literally as an explicitly requested technical practice and left unmapped.
Autonomous vehicles and robotics are excluded as domain experience; communication, research-reading habits, publications, and self-direction are not taxonomy skills.
Transformers and evaluation appear only in the role/problem description and are excluded.
